# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Use [GOALS.md](../GOALS.md), [PLANS.md](../PLANS.md), and [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md) for product context. The score contract is defined in [docs/music-data-format.md](../docs/music-data-format.md).

Keep changes within the requested task, preserve the documented score contract, run relevant checks, and report checks that were not run. Do not implement playback automation or MCP unless the product owner changes scope.
